name: lcars-helm
description: LCARS instrument display for Signal K

scripts.build: tsc -b && tsc -p tsconfig.plugin.json && vite build && vite build --config vite.plugin.config.ts

//: The webapp half ships as `public/` — static files Vite has already bundled React and zustand into — with no runtime dependencies at all, so listing them as `dependencies` would make the boat download React over 4G on every update and never load it. The plugin half ships as `plugin-dist/index.cjs`, a bundle with no dependencies of its own (only node:* built-ins). Everything below is a devDependency for exactly that reason.
